message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Yang used his position (as village official?) to divert village funds (pre-collection of construction fees) for personal use (paying his own eyeglass factory expenses, repaying bank loan). Later he returned the money. This is classic embezzlement (挪用公款) i.e., misappropriation of public funds. In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds). The examples: earlier example with Wang3 (挪用公款) gave answer "挪用公款". So we output that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa>
